entity: FEMA's delay publishing disaster-declaration notices in the Federal Register, Jan-Jun 2025 declarations
what_we_add: median 110 days vs 41-48 before, California's 223-day wait, notices printed on only 3 days in Jan 2025-Aug 2026
why: The Federal Register notices themselves state the fact on their face: January-May 2025 declarations published August 19, and the SBA printed the same California disaster in nine days.
